questions.prompt: Walk me through how state differs from props in React, and describe how changes in state trigger re-rendering in a functional component.
questions.diagnostic_hint: Think about what data is owned locally by the component versus data passed from a parent component.
questions.followup_deep_dive: How does React optimize this re-rendering process using the reconciliation algorithm or React.memo?

questions.prompt: Explain how the Node.js event loop handles asynchronous operations despite JavaScript being single-threaded.
questions.diagnostic_hint: Consider what component handles network and file system calls outside the main V8 execution thread.
questions.followup_deep_dive: What happens if a synchronous CPU-heavy loop runs in your Express controller while 1,000 HTTP requests arrive?

questions.prompt: In MongoDB, how do compound indexes work, and why does the Equality-Sort-Range (ESR) rule dictate field ordering in high-throughput query workloads?
questions.diagnostic_hint: Consider how a B-tree search narrows the index bounds when equality criteria precede range criteria.
questions.followup_deep_dive: If your query scans 100,000 index keys but returns 10 documents, what specific bottleneck does that indicate in your compound index?

questions.prompt: Design a real-time collaborative dashboard where 10,000 concurrent users receive live notification feeds without exhausting server socket connections.
questions.diagnostic_hint: How do multiple Node.js instances communicate with each other when a message arrives on instance A but the user is connected to instance B?
questions.followup_deep_dive: How would you handle automatic client reconnection with backoff jitter if a network partition drops 3,000 connections at once?

questions.prompt: In your past architectural leadership, describe a scenario where you decoupled a monolithic Node/Express service into asynchronous microservices. How did you maintain transaction consistency across service boundaries?
questions.diagnostic_hint: Think about what happens when a database commit succeeds in Service A but the subsequent HTTP call or message publish to Service B fails.
questions.followup_deep_dive: How did you handle compensating transactions when a downstream shipping service failed after credit card debit succeeded?

questions.core_topic: Distributed Multi-Region Cache Invalidation & CAP Trade-offs
questions.prompt: Design a globally distributed e-commerce inventory reservation system with multi-region replication. How do you prevent overselling while maintaining sub-50ms checkout latency during flash sales?
questions.diagnostic_hint: Can you split inventory reservation into regional buckets, or do you need a single source of truth for the final stock count?
questions.followup_deep_dive: What happens during a split-brain scenario where region US-East loses connectivity to EU-West for 120 seconds?

questions.core_topic: Java Memory Model & Garbage Collection Basics
questions.prompt: Explain the difference between the Stack and the Heap memory spaces in the Java Virtual Machine (JVM). How are object references stored?
questions.diagnostic_hint: Which space holds local primitive variables and method call frames versus instantiated objects?
questions.followup_deep_dive: What happens under the hood when you pass an object reference as a parameter into another method in Java?

questions.prompt: How does the @Transactional annotation work in Spring using AOP proxies, and what causes the 'self-invocation' pitfall where transactions fail to roll back?
questions.diagnostic_hint: What happens when method A calls method B in the exact same class instance when method B has @Transactional?
questions.followup_deep_dive: Under what circumstances would you choose SERIALIZABLE isolation over READ_COMMITTED, and what performance penalty does it incur?

questions.prompt: Design a financial payment ingestion pipeline using Apache Kafka and Spring Boot that guarantees exactly-once processing (EOS) even under pod restarts and network rebalances.
questions.diagnostic_hint: How do you link the database state update and Kafka offset commit so they succeed or fail atomically?
questions.followup_deep_dive: How do you monitor and auto-scale consumer group lag without triggering continuous stop-the-world partition rebalances?

questions.prompt: Architect an active-active multi-region Kubernetes deployment spanning AWS and GCP with automated traffic failover, zero downtime database sync, and unified observability.
questions.diagnostic_hint: How do you prevent split-brain routing if the health check probe to one cloud provider fails due to transit fiber degradation?
questions.followup_deep_dive: Describe your automated rollback and canary deployment gate verification strategy in ArgoCD when 0.1% HTTP 500 errors are detected.
